title: GPT-6 Luna: Pricing, Benchmarks, and Performance in 2026
summary: GPT-6 Luna streamlines complex business tasks by prioritizing high-speed execution over deep reasoning. You can determine if this model fits your stack.
body_markdown:
## OpenAI releases GPT-6 Luna for high-speed automation


According to[Docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/about-claude/models/overview) , while frontier models like[Claude](https://claude.com/pricing) Fable 5.1 handle long-horizon agentic work, Luna **targets the "missing middle"** of automation. These tasks require more intelligence than a basic heuristic but must complete in milliseconds to avoid timing out a webhook.


When a previous model took too long to process a SKU mismatch during a recent inventory sync, the delay caused the connection to drop and left orders stuck in a "Pending" status. I spent four hours debugging that failure.


GPT-6 Luna solves this by removing the overhead of deep reasoning for routine logic. Luna is a fast, cost-efficient tier below GPT-6.1 Sol, as reported by[OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/openai/gpt-6-luna) . Developers can now deploy agentic workflows at a fraction of the previous compute cost.


A clear functional split based on the complexity of the "ask" defines the model hierarchy in[Openrouter](https://openrouter.ai/openai/gpt-6-luna-pro) 's analysis.


The GPT-6 family positions GPT-6.1 Sol for balanced logic, with GPT-6 Luna below it as the fast, cost-efficient model for high-volume tasks.


### Understanding the GPT-6 model landscape


Readers should treat these benchmarks as a blueprint for the next generation of operational AI. As OpenAI moves toward modular architectures, the transition from general-purpose models to specialized efficiency layers like Luna will define how businesses scale their background tasks.


### Tiered routing and reasoning modes


In Activepieces, every connector is an agent tool. Once a integration is registered, it functions simultaneously as a deterministic flow step and a tool schema on a per-project MCP server, reachable by Luna through Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor.


This unified catalog, used in production by MoneyGram and FundingSocieties, removes the need to re-integrate or export actions for different execution modes.


Check the Integrations Framework and MCP Server documentation to see how the same integration action in the open source repo is exposed directly as an MCP tool.


**20.7 is the score** GPT-6 Luna earned on the AutomationBench 1.0.6 benchmark by[Zapier](https://atlas.kevinhu.io/benchmarks/automationbench-1-0-6-zapier) .


To bridge this gap without switching models, OpenAI introduced a` reasoning.mode` set to` pro` . As noted by[OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/openai/gpt-6-luna-pro) , this allows the same underlying Luna architecture to produce higher-quality responses for complex tasks. This gives ops managers a toggle between raw speed and accuracy.


Even at the base level, the[OpenAI pricing page](https://openai.com/chatgpt/pricing) confirms a **54K context window** for the "Go" plan. This is double the 27K window of the Free tier. High-speed automations have enough memory to process large JSON payloads without truncation.
